rows.text: We're moving further into the robotics era, and I find developments like this really exciting. Elorian is launching Glimpse, its first model for Visual Thinking. In the team's demo, it breaks a recorded robot task into individual actions, labeling what happens and when. That could make recorded demonstrations much more useful for training robots. Better visual understanding is going to be a big part of teaching machines to work in the physical world. I think the changes we're going to see in manufacturing, logistics and eventually our homes will be enormous. @ElorianAI
rows.quoted: Spent years watching models ace a single image and completely whiff on anything that moves or changes angle. Today we’re fixing that. Try Glimpse now, our first visual thinking model with competitive frontier performance compared to Astra on key public visual reasoning benchmarks.
